headline: Updates on the Holiday Toy Swap, a January 9 Styrofoam event, and the Salem 400+ Volunteer Fair.
summary: Updates cover recent Repair Cafe and Textile Drive events and plans for upcoming events. Old and new business includes a new chairperson, TerraCycle changes, and a fall holiday guide.
items: Past events: Repair Cafe (Nov 7) and Textile Drive (Nov 21)
Old business: new chairperson, TerraCycle changes, committee attendance, and more
New business: measuring results, Swap'N'Drop, leftover pumpkins, and a fall guide
location: City Hall Annex, first floor medium conference room, and via Zoom
